steps.en: Install the binary, then type i in your repo to open a session
steps.zh: 装好二进制，在仓库里敲 i 打开会话

steps.en: Pick a provider and a low-cost model
steps.zh: 选 provider 和一个低成本模型

steps.en: Switch to the harness that model family is used to, then give it the task
steps.zh: 换上该模型家族习惯的 harness，再交代任务

steps.en: Talks to the model with that harness's prompts, tools and edit format
steps.zh: 按这个 harness 的提示词、工具和编辑格式与模型对话

steps.en: Runs commands and edits files inside the OS sandbox, asking per your approval rules
steps.zh: 在 OS 沙箱里跑命令、改文件，按你的审批规则询问

steps.en: Loops run → observe → edit until the task is done
steps.zh: 跑 → 看结果 → 再改，循环到任务完成

value.en: A cheap or open model works inside the scaffolding it does best in, with Codex's sandbox still underneath
value.zh: 便宜或开源模型跑在最适合它的脚手架里，底下照样是 Codex 的沙箱

sources: https://github.com/openinterpreter/openinterpreter#features (/model; native sandboxing; Rust-native model harnesses; exec, permissions)
